modules.title: How To Treat Central Vertigo
modules.sourceDocument: 2. dr. Sri Novianty, Sp.N - How To Treat Central Vertigo.docx
topicTags: Central vertigo arises from lesions along the vestibular pathway from nucleus vestibularis in the brainstem to thalamus and cerebral cortex
Key etiologies include vascular (stroke, TIA), inflammatory (MS), tumor (CPA tumors), epilepsy, trauma, and migraine
Symptomatic treatment uses vestibular suppressants: anticholinergics, antihistamines, benzodiazepines

modules.title: Infeksi Sistem Saraf Pusat
topicTags: Two fundamental principles: Where is the infection? What is the etiology?
HIV status critically changes the differential diagnosis of brain infections
Thwaites score helps differentiate bacterial from TB meningitis

modules.title: Gangguan Gerak
topicTags: Movement disorders are divided into hyperkinetic and hypokinetic categories
Specific basal ganglia structures localize to specific movement disorders: substantia nigra (bradykinesia, tremor), subthalamic nucleus (ballism), caudate (chorea), putamen (dystonia)
TRAP symptoms (Tremor, Rigiditas, Akinesia, Postural instability) define Parkinson disease

modules.title: Central Nervous System Infection and Inflammation
modules.sourceDocument: CENTRAL NEVROS SYSTEM INFECTION   and Inflammation.docx
topicTags: CNS infection progresses through cerebritis (7-10 days) to capsule formation (10-14 days)
MRI is more sensitive than CT for early encephalitis detection
DWI/ADC shows restricted diffusion in encephalitis though less intense than infarction

modules.title: Cerebral Infark - Stroke Radiology
topicTags: Infarct results from circulation deficit due to thrombosis or cerebral emboli
CT may be normal in very early infarction; becomes apparent after 24 hours
Early signs: loss of gray-white matter differentiation, hyperdense MCA sign

modules.title: Rehabilitation of Neurological Disorders
topicTags: Rehabilitation aims to restore optimal physical, emotional, psychological, social, and vocational potential
Four types: medical, vocational, social, psychological rehabilitation
Positioning prevents contractures, pressure ulcers, and musculoskeletal deformities

modules.title: Bangkitan Epileptik
topicTags: Epileptic seizure: transient signs/symptoms from abnormal excessive neuronal activity in the brain (ILAE)
ILAE 2017 classification divides seizures into focal, generalized, and unknown onset
Reflex seizures are triggered by specific stimuli (visual, auditory, somatosensory, motor)

modules.title: Patologi Anatomi Neurologi
topicTags: CNS pathology divided into congenital, cerebrovascular, infectious, and neoplastic categories
Astrocytoma grading: WHO I (pilocytic) to WHO IV (glioblastoma multiforme)
Oligodendroglioma: fried egg appearance, chicken-wire vessels, microcalcifications

modules.title: Manajemen Pasca Stroke dan Koma
topicTags: Post-stroke complications include DVT, aspiration pneumonia, pressure sores, contractures, depression, and nutritional deficits
BP management differs by stroke type: ischemic (permissive hypertension up to 220/120) vs hemorrhagic (aggressive lowering)
Dysphagia screening must occur before any oral intake

modules.title: Mikroorganisme Penyebab Infeksi SSP
topicTags: Pyogenic bacteria: Streptococcus pneumoniae, Neisseria meningitidis, Haemophilus influenzae are leading causes of bacterial meningitis
Mycobacterium tuberculosis causes TB meningitis with characteristic basilar enhancement
Cryptococcus neoformans is the most common fungal CNS pathogen in immunocompromised patients

modules.title: Neuroanatomi 2023
topicTags: ACA supplies medial frontal and parietal lobes; MCA supplies lateral hemisphere; PCA supplies occipital and medial temporal lobes
Internal capsule has anterior limb, genu, posterior limb, retrolenticular, and sublenticular parts - each with specific fiber tracts
Lacunar infarcts commonly affect internal capsule, basal ganglia, thalamus, and pons

modules.title: Neuropati
topicTags: Source file exceeded processing capacity
Filename indicates May 2025 teaching material on neuropathy
Content likely covers peripheral nerve anatomy, classification, and clinical approach

modules.title: Nyeri Kepala
topicTags: SNOOP4 red flags for secondary headache: Systemic symptoms, Neurological signs, Onset sudden, Older age, Pattern change, Precipitated by exertion/cough, Positional, Progressive
Migraine pathophysiology involves trigeminovascular system activation and CGRP release
Acute migraine treatment: NSAIDs, triptans, antiemetics; Preventive: beta-blockers, CCBs, antiepileptics, CGRP antagonists

modules.title: Parkinson Disease - Aspek Klinis
topicTags: Degeneration of dopaminergic neurons in substantia nigra pars compacta causes striatal dopamine deficiency
Lewy bodies (alpha-synuclein aggregates) are pathological hallmark
TRAP symptoms: Tremor, Rigidity, Akinesia/bradykinesia, Postural Instability

modules.title: Patofisiologi Stroke
topicTags: Stroke is defined as rapidly developing clinical signs of focal cerebral disturbance lasting >24 hours or leading to death
Ischemic stroke (85%) results from thrombosis, embolism, or systemic hypoperfusion; Hemorrhagic stroke (15%) from intracerebral hemorrhage or SAH
Ischemic cascade: energy failure -> ion pump dysfunction -> glutamate release -> calcium influx -> free radical production -> inflammation -> cell death

modules.title: Pemeriksaan Klinis Neurologi
topicTags: Source was image-heavy with limited extractable text
Standard neurological examination follows systematic approach
Cranial nerve examination localizes to brainstem and peripheral nerves

modules.title: Diagnosing Vertigo and Dizziness
topicTags: Four types of dizziness: vertigo (spinning), presyncope (lightheadedness), disequilibrium (imbalance), nonspecific dizziness
TIMING is key: seconds = BPPV; minutes-hours = Meniere/TIA; hours-days = vestibular neuritis/migraine; continuous = central
HINTS examination (Head Impulse, Nystagmus, Test of Skew) is more sensitive than MRI for stroke in acute vestibular syndrome

modules.title: Gangguan Keseimbangan
topicTags: Balance depends on integration of vestibular (inner ear), visual, and proprioceptive (somatosensory) systems processed by the cerebellum and brainstem
Romberg test evaluates proprioception; sharpened Romberg adds challenge
Fukuda stepping test: >30 degrees rotation or >50cm displacement suggests vestibular asymmetry

modules.title: Radiologi Tumor Cerebri
topicTags: High-grade gliomas show irregular ring enhancement, central necrosis, surrounding edema, mass effect
Meningioma: extra-axial, broad dural base, homogeneous enhancement, dural tail sign
Acoustic neuroma: CPA mass, extends into internal auditory canal (ice cream cone sign)

modules.title: Status Epileptikus
topicTags: Operational definition: 5 minutes of continuous seizures OR two or more discrete seizures without full recovery between
Time-dependent treatment: benzodiazepines (0-5 min), IV antiepileptics (5-20 min), anesthetic agents (20-60 min) for refractory SE
Mortality increases with duration: ~3% at 10-29 min, 19% at >30 min, 32% at >60 min

modules.title: Stroke Radiology
topicTags: Non-contrast CT is first-line to exclude hemorrhage in acute stroke
ASPECTS score (0-10) quantifies early ischemic changes; score <7 suggests large infarct with poor thrombolysis outcome
Hyperdense MCA sign indicates thrombus in the vessel - key sign for thrombectomy candidacy

modules.title: Trauma Sistem Saraf
topicTags: GCS classifies TBI: mild (13-15), moderate (9-12), severe (3-8)
Epidural hematoma: lens-shaped (biconvex), arterial (middle meningeal artery), does not cross sutures
Subdural hematoma: crescent-shaped, venous (bridging veins), crosses suture lines but not dural attachments

modules.title: Tumor Cerebri
topicTags: Primary CNS tumors: gliomas (astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma, glioblastoma) are most common malignant; meningioma most common benign
Metastases are the most common brain tumors overall (lung, breast, melanoma, kidney, colon)
General symptoms: headache (worse in morning, with Valsalva), nausea/vomiting, papilledema, cognitive/personality changes

modules.title: Tumor Sistem Saraf Pusat
topicTags: WHO CNS5 2021 integrates histology and molecular markers for integrated diagnosis
Adult vs pediatric brain tumors differ in type, location, and prognosis
Clinical presentation depends on: rate of growth, location, size, edema

lectureDomains.title: Psychiatry & Behavior / Batch 2 6F (Kimi Rerun)
lectureDomains.summary: Enhanced structured content from Kimi rerun for 14 psychiatry lecturer modules.

modules.title: Gangguan Kepribadian dan Perilaku Masa Dewasa
modules.sourceDocument: ✅28_4_25 GGN KEPRIBADIAN DAN PERILAKU MASA DEWASA_compressed.docx
topicTags: Kepribadian (dari bahasa Latin 'persona' = topeng) mencakup aspek karakter internal dan eksternal yang bersifat unik, relatif stabil, dan memengaruhi perilaku dalam berbagai situasi
Gangguan kepribadian = pola pikiran, perasaan, dan perilaku yang menetap dan maladaptif bagi individu serta masyarakat; individu seringkali tidak menyadari adanya masalah
Klaster A (Aneh/Eksentrik): Paranoid, Skizoid, Skizotipal

modules.title: Gangguan Ansietas dan Penatalaksanaannya - GAM
topicTags: Anxiety = disguised fear with autonomic symptoms; normal adaptive response to threat (fight or flight)
GAM = chronic anxiety disorder with excessive, uncontrollable, pervasive worry lasting months, accompanied by somatic and psychic symptoms
Neuroanatomy involves amygdala (emotional response), medial prefrontal cortex (modulation/decision-making), and hippocampus (memory encoding)

modules.title: Gangguan Panik
topicTags: Term 'panic' originates from Pan, Greek half-ghost god of mountains
First described by Sigmund Freud in 1895 in a case of agoraphobia
Lifetime prevalence 1.5-5%; female:male ratio 2-3:1; peak onset around age 25

modules.title: Fobia
topicTags: Phobia from Greek 'phobos' = fear; excessive and unreasonable fear toward specific objects/situations with avoidance
Classical conditioning: phobia develops because something is conditioned as frightening or dangerous
Biological: danger signal to amygdala stores fear associated with object/situation

modules.title: Gangguan Makan: Bulimia dan Anorexia Nervosa
topicTags: Lecture covers two main eating disorders: Bulimia and Anorexia Nervosa
Lecturer: Dr. Tumpak Saragi, SpKJ
Source contains 33 slides with predominantly image-based content

modules.title: Delirium
topicTags: Delirium = acute confusional state with decreased attention, cognitive dysfunction, sleep-wake disturbance, and altered psychomotor activity; onset is acute and fluctuating
Synonyms include: Acute Brain Syndrome, Acute Confusional State, Toxic Psychosis, Metabolic Encephalopathy, Altered Mental Status, Dysergastic State
Epidemiology: 10-15% general surgical, 15-25% general medical, 30% surgical/cardiac ICU, 40-50% hip fracture surgery, 20% major burns, ~30% hospitalized AIDS

modules.title: Amnesia Pasca Trauma
topicTags: Lecturer: dr. Fatmawati, Sp.KJ
Topic: Amnesia Pasca Trauma (Post-Traumatic/Dissociative Amnesia)
26 slides total, all image-based

modules.title: Gangguan Somatoform
topicTags: Lecturer: dr. Fatmawati, Sp.KJ
Topic: Gangguan Somatoform (Somatoform Disorders)
42 slides total, all image-based

modules.title: Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT) dan Psikoterapi
topicTags: ECT is the oldest psychiatric treatment still in use; most effective for major depression
Only 20% of electrical charge enters the skull due to high impedance; modern machines deliver constant current/voltage/energy
PET studies: seizure increases CBF, glucose, O2 use; post-ictal frontal hypometabolism correlates with response

modules.title: Isu Etik dan Legal dalam Kesehatan Jiwa
topicTags: Florence Nightingale pledge: 4 domains - help the sick achieve health, help the healthy maintain health, help the incurable realize potential, help the dying live optimally
UU No.29/2004 Pasal 52: patient rights include full explanation, second opinion, appropriate service, refusal of treatment, access to medical records
Restraint = direct application of physical force to restrict movement; Seclusion = involuntary confinement in specially constructed room

modules.title: Pemeriksaan Laboratorium pada Penyalahgunaan Obat Psikoaktif, NAPZA dan Alkohol
modules.sourceDocument: Pemeriksaan Laboratorium pada penyalahgunaan obat psikoaktif, NAPZA.docx
topicTags: Narkotika: heroin (putauw), cannabis (cimeng), cocaine, morphine, codeine
Psychotropics: sabu (amphetamine/methamphetamine), sedatives (diazepam, etc.)
Psychoactive substance = substance affecting CNS causing mental, emotional, and behavioral changes

modules.title: Prilaku Profesional, Anamnesa dan Pemeriksaan Psikiatri
topicTags: Psychiatric interview includes anamnesis, MSE, diagnosis/prognosis, and psychotherapy
Rapport = trust + understanding; essential for patient disclosure
Open-ended questions first, then closed for specifics; combine both for best results

modules.title: Normal Sleep dan Sleep Disorders
topicTags: Humans spend 1/3 of life sleeping; need 6-8 hours/day; infants/children need more
Sleep is essential for survival; prolonged deprivation causes severe physical/cognitive damage and death
NREM = 75% of sleep (4 stages); REM = 25%; 4-6 cycles per night

Untuk niembantu menegakkan diagnosa, dokter menghitung Siriraj Stroke Score. Berapakah skor nya?
